creators.provenance: creator-reported on first-party website; article also reports a largest reel passing one million

interpretation: Million-view creator reports support investigating the format. They do not prove that a specific caption style or feature caused reach. Likes are not views. Outlier ratios need a reel's views and a comparable recent account median.
